Making a presentation look professional starts with removing what makes it look amateur:

· All bullet points.
· The template your client already saw.
· Charts pasted in as screenshots.
· Four different typefaces.
· A "Thank you" slide as the closer.

Save it and check your next presentation before you send it. Or hand it to Deckly.
